CashFlowMeta.description:
Metadata shared by an entire cashflow schedule.

Carries the representation tag, the issue and maturity dates, projected
fixings for time rolls, and two informational fields (`calendar_ids`,
`commitment`) that no Rust engine reads.

calendar_ids.description:
Holiday calendar IDs used for schedule adjustments.

Informational: carried through merge and host views, but no Rust
engine reads it; accrual uses each flow's `accrual.calendar_id`.

commitment.description:
Total facility commitment for revolving and delayed-draw facilities;
`None` for instruments without one.

Informational: carried through merge and host views, but no Rust
engine reads it.

issue_date.description:
Issue date of the instrument.

Required by accrual and by `outstanding_by_date` /
`outstanding_at_dates`, which return an error when it is missing rather
than infer the first coupon period start from flow dates. `validate`
and the public lifecycle normalization instead fall back to the first
flow date to locate the issue funding row. Merging schedules keeps it
only when every input carries the same date.

maturity.description: Contractual maturity date, distinct from an adjusted final payment date.

projected_fixings.description:
Raw index observations used by projected floating coupons, before spread,
gearing, caps and floors; retained for deterministic time-roll fixings.

representation.description: Meaning of the schedule relative to waterfall policy.

CashflowRepresentation.description: Meaning of the emitted schedule relative to pricing and waterfall policy.

oneOf.description: Fixed or contractually scheduled future dated cash amounts.
Current-market or model-projected future dated cash amounts.
Intentionally empty because the contingent payoff policy is not modeled yet.
Intentionally empty because no future dated cashflows remain.

ProjectedFixing.description: One raw index observation needed by a projected floating coupon.

date.description: Contractual index observation date, after fixing-calendar adjustments.

series_id.description: Canonical market-series identifier, including the `FIXING:` prefix.

value.description:
Raw observed quantity in the index convention: annualized decimal rate
before spread/gearing/caps/floors for rates, or quote currency per base
currency for an FX fixing series. The series identifier fixes orientation.
`None` records an observation for which the coupon's fallback policy
masked a missing projection dependency; a time roll must supply an
existing fixing or fail explicitly when crossing that date.

description: Schedule-level inputs for building a schedule from existing flows.

notional_hint.description:
Optional notional amount to stamp on the resulting schedule. When
`None`, the constructor uses a zero notional in the currency of the
first supplied flow (or USD if the list is empty).
